Understand scores and files
The score uses every check that finished. Passed checks add to the score; failed checks lower it. Checks that could not run, do not apply, or still need a live preview are shown separately and do not change the score. File scores are helpful signals, not guarantees.

Connection and token options

A remembered token is stored in this browser, never inside uploaded projects or published HTML. Other pages sharing this site's origin may access browser storage; use a fine-grained token.

GitHub publishing requires internet access. Allow repository Contents write, Pages write, and Administration write where required; repository creation needs Repository creation permission.
